title: Total Junk
text: Total Junk. Whatever you do, do not buy this frame. If it was 5-10 dollars, then it might be acceptable. First of all, the frame has nowhere to put multiple pictures. When you take the back off, it is one large open space, so if you want to display more than one picture (as the front of the frame suggests), then you MUST make a collage and piecemeal things together on the glass with tape. There is nothing to hold the pictures in the frame and they slide all over. Second, the frame is not wood, it appears to be cardboard. This is an extremely bad frame you'd expect at the dollar store, not here at this insane price.
